summary: Tillamook County lookout on Hembre Ridge: a 40-foot tower planned in 1936 and built about 1949-1952, removed in 1973 (one listing says destroyed 1965); no remains described.

facts.design: 40-foot tower; sources differ on construction (pole, timber, or aluminum house), and one listing gives a 14x14 ft cab
facts.status_note: Tower removed in 1973 per the register and Oregon Lookouts; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1965; no source describes what remains

events.note: A committee on protection of the state's most serious forest fire sector recommended three new lookout stations for the Tillamook burn area; a Hembre Ridge lookout was planned (Daily Capital Journal, as quoted by Oregon Lookouts)
40-foot timber tower with 14x14 cab erected (Oregon Lookouts)
Register: 40-foot pole live-in tower built around 1950
firelookout.com says destroyed; the register and Oregon Lookouts give 1973 removal instead

evidence.supports: committee on protection of the state's most serious forest fire sector recommended three new lookout stations, April 1936
evidence.quote: Construction of three new lookout stations, establishment of fire breaks and the purchase of additional fire fighting equipment for the Tillamook burn area were recommended

evidence.supports: recommended to Governor Martin by the state's committee on protection of its most serious forest fire sector, April 15, 1936
evidence.quote: recommended to Governor Martin today by his committee on protection of the state's most serious forest fire sector

evidence.supports: a lookout planned on Hembre Ridge in the western part of the 1933 burned area

evidence.quote: Hembre Ridge lookout, which is an aluminum house on a 40-foot tower, has been finished.

evidence.quote: A 40' pole live-in tower was built around 1950 and removed in 1973.

notes_for_editor: Dates and design conflict across three sources. Built: 1949 (Oregon Lookouts), about 1950 (register), 1952 (firelookout.com). Construction: pole live-in tower (register, firelookout.com) versus timber tower with 14x14 cab (Oregon Lookouts) versus aluminum house on a 40-foot tower (1951 Bulletin #3, quoted by Oregon Lookouts). Removal: 1973 (register, Oregon Lookouts) versus destroyed 1965 (firelookout.com); not reconciled. Access and today's condition are not described in any source; the 2007 register photo is not described beyond its credit line, so it was not used as evidence of condition. Record access 'unknown' left as is. Height 12.2 m in the record matches 40 ft in all three sources. Elevation 898.6 m in the record matches the register's 899 m.
